summary: Iteration 9 - full E2E test of NEW Electron desktop architecture (FastAPI engine at 127.0.0.1:8971 + React UI served from electron/dist). Backend: created /app/9x_security/test_service_api.py with 20 pytest cases covering auth (login OK/401, protected endpoints), state/counts/events (+filters+all=1), line set + persistence, swap toggle, options invalid-class filtering, settings roundtrip (wa_api_key, wa_recipients, gh_token, auth_user), password change + restore to 9xsecurity, camera test (TEST-NET), camera connect/disconnect + status polling, stream headers (multipart/x-mixed-replace), snapshot path security (403 outside, 404 missing), whatsapp fake-key (ok=false), update check dev-mode. Regression: engine + iter5/6/7 test files all still pass. Total 71/71 pytest cases green in 47s. Frontend: Playwright E2E against http://127.0.0.1:8971/ - login page renders with dark left panel; wrong password shows login-error 'Galat username ya password'; correct login (admin/9xsecurity) opens dashboard with all data-testids present (camera-panel, stat-entries-today, stat-exits-today, controls-panel, events-panel, sidebar); Settings page shows 4 tabs (whatsapp/account/security/updates); WhatsApp save fires success toast and reload persists values; Updates tab Check-Update shows dev-mode message; Dashboard draw-line-btn toggles mode + two camera-view clicks POSTs /api/line and shows success toast; swap-direction-btn fires toast; camera-test-btn with TEST-NET URL opens test-result-modal with URL check ✔ and network ✘ steps; modal close works; events filter/showAll buttons work; logout returns to login. Static index serves 200 and assets load with no console errors (only expected 401s during login attempts). Design matches guidelines (dark sidebar + light dashboard, blue #1f6feb accents, proper spacing). Password restored to 9xsecurity as required.
critical_code_review_comments: service.py probe_rtsp short-circuits after network failure (2 steps returned instead of 4) - correct behavior but the review request example expected ~4 steps; documented and test updated to accept >=2.

service.py /api/stream generator has no client-disconnect handling and no upper time bound - fine for MJPEG intent but could accumulate goroutines if browser holds many tabs open; consider StreamingResponse's built-in disconnect detection.
Worker.apply_cfg silently swallows exceptions on notifier.update / detector.set_allowed - if config becomes malformed later, no log. Minor.

Login stores token in setToken() presumably in localStorage - fine for local desktop; no expiry/rotation but token set is process-lifetime only (in-memory _tokens set) so restart invalidates all (good).
SettingsPage sends full settings body including wa_recipients list on every save; unchanged 'gh_token' field is echoed back too. Fine but could leak old values if UI ever loads partial state.
